title: PythonScriptRunner StartPipelineRun command (psr.start-pipeline-run.v1)
description: Publish to the exchange psr.public with the routing key pipeline.start (AMQP type psr.start-pipeline-run.v1, content type application/json). The run is announced with run.queued, or refused with run.rejected; both carry the correlationId.

version.description: Version to run; null runs the latest published version.

inputs.description: Pipeline inputs in the wire format of the data mapping. Files are not accepted: pipelines with file inputs are rejected.

idempotencyKey.description: Repeated commands with the same key within 24 hours return the same run. Without it, the AMQP message_id is used.

correlationId.description: Returned in every event of the run.

requestedBy.description: Name of the calling system; the run is triggered by queue:<requestedBy>.
